verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party data-export capability for Google Drive, such as a bulk export tool or documented export to open formats. The files.list API (google-drive-docs-10) is only a developer building block. rclone exporting Google Docs to ODF (google-drive-comm-5, google-drive-comm-13) is a third-party, user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
